messages:
Sophia: Hey folks, visiting a client in Little Italy tomorrow — any must-try gelato spots nearby? Low-key afternoon treat. 🍨
Matt: Vesuvio Gelato on Mott is the OG. Pistachio is unreal.
Alexa: +1 for Vesuvio but if you want something lighter try Gelato Piccolo on Grand. Their stracciatella is thin shavings, not chunks. Cash-only some days.
Riley: Also Bacio + Crema has a solid vegan coconut and a nice vibe. 10 min walk from the office.
James: If you want to sit and chill, La Piazza does an affogato that's worth the extra 2 blocks. Outdoor tables in good weather.
Noah: Heads-up: a couple spots close around 7pm on weekdays, but afternoons are safe.
Matt: Quick list with addresses I pulled earlier:
```
Vesuvio Gelato — 142 Mott St (📍Mott & Broome)
Gelato Piccolo — 88 Grand St (cash or card machine varies)
Bacio + Crema — 205 Mulberry St (vegan-friendly)
La Piazza — 9 Prince St (affogato)
```
Alexa: Also: Gelato Piccolo sometimes has seasonal fig — if you're into that.
Sophia: Amazing recs, thanks! Can folks vote so I pick one? :thumbsup: Vesuvio, :heart: Gelato Piccolo, :laughing: Bacio
Matt: :thumbsup: (Vesuvio)
Alexa: :heart: (Gelato Piccolo)
Riley: :laughing: (Bacio)
James: Leaning Vesuvio but love Gelato Piccolo too.
Sophia: Sweet. I'll aim for Vesuvio at 15:30 tomorrow. Anyone want to join? @Riley @James @Matt
Riley: I'm in.
James: Same here.
